{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute correlation within each island
corr_by_island = penguins_clean.groupby('island').apply(
    lambda x: x['flipper_length_mm'].corr(x['body_mass_g'])
)

# Compute correlation within each species
corr_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species').apply(
    lambda x: x['flipper_length_mm'].corr(x['body_mass_g'])
)

# Print results
print("Correlation by island:")
print(corr_by_island)
print("\nCorrelation by species:")
print(corr_by_species)"}
